items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Injury report; confirmed via Tim McManus.
items.implication: AJ Brown massive target share; Goedert/others elevated; Saquon still expected.
items.opportunity: AJ Brown WR1 ceiling; Dallas Goedert TE boost.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; practiced limited but ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and dual-threat upside limited; Henry volume secure.
items.opportunity: Increased Henry carries/goal-line; Flowers/Bateman/Andrews targets with Huntley.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE after limited Thu/DNP Fri; McVay calls minor but power/explosion limited; GTD vs Raiders.
items.why: Calf issue in practice; Rapoport notes more minor than anything but not precautionary.
items.implication: Crucial DFS/slate swing; if out Rams lean run/TE heavy with Adams already OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee lead TE, Kyren/Corum boost, Mumpfield WR1.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at DET.
items.implication: Lead back return; Berry notes post-layoff caution possible but volume there.

items.text: Christian Kirk activated for 49ers debut; Jordan Mason activated expected play for MIN; Tank Dell activated HOU season debut.
items.why: Official activations Saturday; expected to play.
items.implication: Kirk helps depleted SF WR; Mason committee with Jones?; Dell boosts HOU pass.

items.text: Saquon Barkley QUESTIONABLE (hamstring) but expected to play MNF vs DAL; DeVonta OUT confirmed.
items.why: Returned to practice limited; Eagles report expected.
items.implication: Berry loves if active; full workload likely with WR injuries.

items.text: Levitan: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses very crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; hoping early news. Flags sneaky OUT scratches BRob/Warren/Egbuka/Jahwar Jordan.
items.why: High leverage on ownership/projections if change.
items.implication: Pivot plans essential; Lamar already OUT confirmed later.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE after limited practice return; game-time vs Dolphins; crucial DFS status.
items.why: Quad injury multi-week; limited Thu/Fri improvement.
items.implication: If active likely committee; if OUT Braelon Allen RB1 upside vs weak MIA run D.
items.opportunity: Allen full work if Hall inactive.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson full bellcow expected vs SF.
items.why: Hamstring; listed OUT in ETR dump; Levitan flags sneaky scratch.

items.text: Davante Adams, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel all OUT; 49ers WR room depleted, CMC slot tempted.
items.why: Adams hamstring IR-ish; Evans Achilles/multi; Deebo OUT.
items.implication: Kirk debut helps 49ers; CMC more slot/routes per Levitan.
items.opportunity: CMC receiving upside; Kittle funnel; Kirk targets.

items.text: Rashee Rice, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Zach Charbonnet, Jeremiyah Love all OUT; sneaky important per Levitan.
items.why: ETR Sunday dump lists; Levitan flags as sneaky scratches.
items.implication: KC WR depth to Worthy/others; TB without Egbuka; IND TE without Warren; DET RB to Gibbs full; SEA to Walker/Wilson.
items.opportunity: Jahmyr Gibbs monopoly; Kenneth Walker full; Xavier Worthy boost.

items.text: Rarely buys RB-as-WR hype but tempted by CMC more slot this week amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out) and Kaelon Black presence; CMC smiled at question.
items.why: WR injuries force creativity; CMC quote + smile.
items.opportunity: More slot snaps, targets in pass game.
items.conflict: Usual skepticism on RB WR alignments rarely materialize.

items.text: Koerner: Puka rank range WR1 to OUT; no sit/start yet, have plan; if out Mumpfield WR41, Higbee top-10 TE, Kyren/Corum boost, Stafford yards down.
Berry pushes Jonah Coleman roster in 100% leagues; will be Broncos RB you wish you had by year end; activated expected to play.
items.why: Preseason call + activation off IR; Badie to IR.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins and Jordan Addison (plus Hockenson) listed IN/expected to play.
items.why: ETR IN list; full practice confirmations.
items.implication: Judkins CLE RB work; Addison MIN WR2 with JJ.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10) especially with DeVonta/Wicks OUT; also Kraft TE vs DET soft.
items.why: Usage + Bears/Lions soft pass D; confirmed post-OUT news.
items.implication: AJB elite WR1; Kraft TE1 upside.
items.opportunity: AJB 30%+ target share; Kraft RZ/TE volume.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze (vs Gonzalez shadow, low floor) and Josh Downs; also fades Kelce/Jacobs post-layoff in some contexts.
items.why: Tough CB matchup for Odunze; Downs limited role/usage.

items.text: Berry LOVES Saquon if active, Bucky Irving, Chuba Hubbard, Jaylen Warren; context Loveland 30% TS.
items.implication: Start with confidence in good spots.
